verdict.rationale: Relay explicitly offers high-yield savings accounts (up to 3.00% APY) with automated transfer rules that move idle/excess cash from operating accounts into savings, directly matching the finance-lead's cash cushion story, and community evidence corroborates automatic partitioning of funds with extra interest on allocated cash. Missing for 10: independent verification of actual APY delivery/reliability at scale and more detailed documentation of rule configuration options (percentage vs threshold triggers).
